admission.justification: Guards the costly error this statement names: An atomic write raises OverflowError after it has replaced its destination when a file beside the destination is named like a leftover temporary file whose process number is 214748

applicability: The atomic write's cleanup when a file beside the destination carries a process number the operating system cannot take.
conditions: The destination was already replaced before the cleanup ran.
exclusions: File names that carry a usable process number whose process is gone.
statement: An atomic write raises OverflowError after it has replaced its destination when a file beside the destination is named like a leftover temporary file whose process number is 2147483648 or larger.
